title: Pre-Registration: EFC dN/dM (z>7) Halo Mass Function via µ(a) Perturbation Channel
description: Sealed pre-registration of an Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) prediction for the high-redshift (z=7–12) halo mass function n(M,z) derived via the µ(a) perturbation channel and a gated background. The work locks the structural chain g(a) → µ(a) → D(a) → σ(M,z) → n(M,z), specifies datasets (JWST CEERS/COSMOS-Web/GLASS), HMF prescriptions (Press–Schechter, Sheth–Tormen, Tinker 2008/2010), and explicit falsification thresholds, to be executed once (B, zt, n) are fixed by a joint S(z) fit.

background_gate_deltaE2.description: Background-level modification to the Friedmann equation induced by the EFC gate function; sign lemma implies \Delta E^2 \le 0 for z > 0 if g(a) is monotonic in a.

gate_function.description: EFC gate function with transition redshift z_t and steepness n controlling when and how sharply the gate activates.

mu_effective_coupling.description: Effective gravitational coupling in the perturbation channel that modifies the Poisson source; B is the perturbation amplitude.

modified_growth_ode.description: Differential equation for the linear growth rate f = d\ln D/d\ln a with EFC’s \mu(a) modification; integrates to the growth factor D(a).

prediction_chain.latex: g(a; z_t, n) \to \mu(a; B, z_t, n) \to D(a) \to \sigma(M,z) \to n(M,z)
prediction_chain.description: Sealed structural chain from gate to halo mass function; no HMF-level parameter fitting once (B, z_t, n) are fixed by the joint S(z) fit.

sigma_variance.description: Mass variance computed from the Planck-anchored linear power spectrum, the top-hat window W, and the EFC-modified growth D(z).

hmf_generic.description: General halo mass function form; f(\nu) specified by Press–Schechter, Sheth–Tormen, or Tinker prescriptions computed in parallel.

key_results.main_finding: A sealed, falsifiable EFC prediction for n(M,z) at z=7–12 is registered via the µ(a) channel with explicit pass/fail criteria and three parallel HMF prescriptions; numerical curves will be produced once (B, zt, n) are fixed by the joint S(z) fit.

sealed_predictions.statement: Given (B, zt, n) fixed by the joint S(z) fit, the EFC chain g→µ→D→σ→n yields unique, parameter-free (at the HMF level) predictions for n(M,z) at z = 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 under an identical stellar-to-halo mapping used for ΛCDM.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Disagreement with JWST CEERS/COSMOS-Web/GLASS halo abundance in any redshift slice at >3σ, or joint comparison exceeding the pre-registered ∆χ² threshold.

sealed_predictions.statement: The EFC perturbation coupling obeys µ(a) = 1 − B g(a) with µ(a) < 1 in the gate-active regime and transitions controlled by (zt, n) consistent with the background gate.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Any requirement for µ(a) > 1 or non-monotonic behavior inconsistent with the sealed gate function to match data.

sealed_predictions.statement: Robustness across HMF modeling: Press–Schechter, Sheth–Tormen, and Tinker 2008/2010 computed from the same σ(M,z) must give a consistent verdict regarding agreement with data.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Simultaneous (>3σ) failure of all three prescriptions to match JWST counts once parameters are fixed by the S(z) fit.

kill_criteria: KC1: After fixing (B, zt, n) by the joint S(z) fit, the sealed EFC n(M,z) curves produce >3σ disagreement with JWST CEERS, COSMOS-Web, or GLASS number densities in any tested z ∈ {7,8,9,10,11,12} under an identical stellar-to-halo mapping applied to both EFC and ΛCDM.

KC2: The joint comparison to JWST counts yields a ∆χ² exceeding the pre-registered acceptance threshold (accept if ∆χ² < 4; falsify if above threshold), evaluated consistently across mass thresholds used by the surveys.

KC3: All three HMF prescriptions (Press–Schechter, Sheth–Tormen, Tinker 2008/2010), computed from the same σ(M,z), simultaneously fail to match the data within uncertainties, indicating a channel-level failure rather than a modeling-choice artifact.

KC4: The joint S(z) calibration cannot determine (B, zt, n) within Entropy-Bounded Empiricism (EBE) bounds (i.e., requires entropy-violating parameter excursions), preventing issuance of sealed curves.
KC5: Matching the data would require altering the sealed structural chain (introducing HMF-level tuning or allowing µ(a) > 1 or a non-gate-consistent form), violating the pre-registration.
